title: Patna High Court Assistant Online Form 2026
organization: High Court of Judicature at Patna
vacancyDetails: 68 Ex-Cadre Assistant (Group-C) posts under Patna High Court Recruitment Examination 2026

shortDescription: Patna High Court Ex-Cadre Assistant Online Form 2026 for 68 Group-C posts. Apply 28 July–27 August 2026 at patnahighcourt.gov.in. Graduation + computer certificate.
content:
The High Court of Judicature at Patna has released the notification for Ex-Cadre Assistant (Group-C) Recruitment Examination 2026 for 68 posts.

Online applications: 28 July 2026 to 27 August 2026 (till 23:59 hrs). Fee payment facility continues as per notice (including a short reopening window for those who submitted the form on time).

Eligibility

  • Graduate degree from a recognized university
  • Minimum 6-month Computer Application Certificate / Diploma
  • Age: 18–37 years (male general – check notice for female/category limits)

Fee

  • General / BC / EBC / EWS: ₹1500
  • SC / ST / PH: ₹750

Apply only through patnahighcourt.gov.in. No other mode of application is accepted.
